about.description: ETF perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, cash-settled, 24/7, up to 20x leverage, margined in USDC. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-08-19: mark $770.9300, open interest $2.87M, 24h volume $4.01M. Added 2026-08-19 to reconcile the registry with Ondo's stated 35 RWA markets; the adapter's 40 rows include 5 crypto perps (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, ONDO) that are out of scope.
